container: background-color: #f5f8fb; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(29, 90, 138, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(29, 90, 138, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px; padding: 40px 14px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
card: background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #1d5a8a; border-radius: 0; padding: 24px 20px; margin: 0 0 34px
p: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.8; color: #23405c; margin: 0 0 16px; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2_prefix_html: §
h2_text_style: display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #1d5a8a; color: #1d5a8a; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 14px
h3_prefix_html: ▹
blockquote: border: 1px dashed #b26a1b; background-color: #fdf8f0; padding: 14px 18px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #8a5c22; font-size: 14.5px
code: color: #23405c; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #e7eff7; color: #1d5a8a; padding: 1px 6px; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
list_prefix_html: ▹
list_item: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.8; color: #23405c; margin: 0 0 10px; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #1d5a8a; color: #f5f8fb; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #c9d9e8; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px
